setup_heroku_server: setup a Heroku server for a given task name by downloading the CLI, creating the app, and pushing code
delete_heroku_server: delete a Heroku server for a given task name by destroying the app via the Heroku CLI
setup_local_server: setup a local Node.js server for a given task name by installing npm packages and starting server.js
delete_local_server: delete a local server for a given task name by terminating the process and cleaning the temp directory
setup_server: setup either a Heroku or local server for a given task name using the local flag to choose the backend
